description: Latency questions answered from the four registers — risks, issues, change requests and deliverables. These are read as SQL rows, never retrieved, so there is no document that 'should' come back and expect_documents is deliberately absent. ⚠️ This set is for latency_bench only. Scoring it with retrieval_eval would count every question as a miss and drop the baseline for a reason that has nothing to do with retrieval. It exists because STATUS_AND_ROADMAP §25b reported AC08 failing on exactly this kind of question while the benchmark contained none of them, so the tool that should have caught that regression could not have.
corpus: Registers as seeded by migration 020: 64 risks, 21 issues, 12 change requests, 27 deliverables across 9 projects, as at 2026-11-08

questions.question: ما المخاطر النشطة في المشروع ومن يملكها؟
questions.note: PRJ-02 holds 11 risks. The counting question from §25b, which is why the heading carries a computed tally.

questions.question: ما طلبات التغيير المقدمة على المشروع؟
ما أبرز المخاطر وما خطط التخفيف المرتبطة بها؟
questions.note: PRJ-03 holds 13 risks, the largest register, and the only project with recorded due dates.

questions.question: هل هناك مخاطر مُصعّدة إلى لجنة التوجيه؟
questions.note: The statuses are not a controlled vocabulary (§25a), so this asks for one author's wording.

questions.question: Which risks are still open, and who owns them?
What is the status of the agreed deliverables?
Are there any open issues blocking this project?
أعطني ملخصاً عن risks و issues و change requests في المشروع
questions.note: All four registers in one turn — the largest prompt this set produces, and the one most likely to break the budget.

questions.question: ما المخاطر المسجلة على المشروع؟
questions.note: PRJ-04 has no risk rows at all. The correct answer is that none are recorded — a fast path that must not be mistaken for the slow one when reading the numbers.
